annotations.title: Check a person in or out

description: WRITE: record attendance for one person at one event instance — check them in (default) or check them out (records when they left; checking out someone not checked in creates a record with matching in/out times). Breeze: GET /api/events/attendance/add.

instance_id.description: Numeric Breeze id of the event instance.

person_id.description: Numeric Breeze id of the person.

name: breeze_record_attendance
